summary: Minimal, correct fix wrapping AnnotationBbox.draw in renderer.open_group/close_group with the artist gid, matching the established matplotlib convention used by other artists. Resolves the reported missing-gid-in-SVG issue cleanly.

issues.description: No inline comment, but none needed — the open_group/close_group gid pattern is idiomatic across the codebase and self-explanatory.
